title: Takara Dudley:
title_short: Takara Dudley · Can't Do That Without Shoes
headline: Shoes are how a child gets to school. A brand new pair, fresh out of the box, sends them out happy.
story: Takara Dudley runs the Homeless and Highly Mobile Department at Minneapolis Public Schools. She says it simply: you need shoes to get on the bus and go to school. Most donations her students get are used. A brand new pair, with that new-shoe smell, is different.
She remembers one small boy, feet kicking because they didn't reach the floor. She brought her own teenager to volunteer. Give a little of yourself and it comes back. Warm and positive. No pity.
